FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Pinnacle Financial Advisors, we specialize in providing tailored financial planning and investment management services to clients, including individuals, families, and small businesses. Our operations involve comprehensive financial analysis, retirement planning, tax planning, and investment strategy formulation, ensuring that all recommendations are aligned with our clients' goals and risk tolerance. We maintain a commitment to ethical standards and regulatory compliance, adhering strictly to SEC and FINRA guidelines. Our team is composed of certified financial planners and investment analysts who regularly participate in professional development to stay updated on industry trends and best practices. Additionally, we prioritize the security of client data by implementing robust cybersecurity measures, including encryption and secure client communications. We also regularly conduct internal audits and compliance reviews to identify and mitigate potential operational risks, allowing us to maintain high standards of service while safeguarding our clients' financial interests.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On January 10, 2023, a client filed a complaint regarding perceived negligence in investment advice, seeking damages of $50,000. The matter has been resolved through mediation, and no payment was made by Pinnacle Financial Advisors. Status: Closed.

FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system with 24/7 monitoring and a security fencing perimeter around the property.
